name: yf_actions
description:
Corporate actions (dividends and stock splits together) for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance actions).
Returns: {symbol, actions: [{Date, Dividends, Stock Splits}]}, oldest first, at most the first 100 rows; a row has 0 in the column that does not apply.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
One kind only: yf_dividends or yf_splits. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
